title: 第21章 洪悦儿第22章 躺赚
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
“公子，苒苒愿以身相许，报答您的救命之恩。”段苒苒声音带着丝丝颤抖。
她身姿温软，面容亦有倾国之貌，肌肤胜雪，眉眼间透着楚楚动人之态。
苏铭微微皱眉，毫不犹豫地拒绝：“姑娘，此事万万不可。”
“公子，苒苒身子干净，且绝不会缠着公子，只是段家实在拿不出值钱之物，唯有以此报恩，求公子成全。”段苒苒急切地说道，眼中满是哀求。
苏铭神色坚定，语气诚恳：“姑娘莫要如此，我苏铭绝非那种随便之人，救你不过是举手之劳，无需报酬，姑娘莫要有心理压力。”
段苒苒闻言，身子猛地一颤，脸上血色瞬间褪去，如遭雷击。她嘴唇哆嗦，却再也说不出话来。
最终，她脚步踉跄，缓缓转身，那背影满是绝望，一步步离去，似被抽去了所有力气。
苏铭望着她离去的方向，心中轻叹，已然瞧出她心有死志。
“罢了，怎能眼睁睁看着她寻死。”苏铭暗自呢喃，眼神中闪过一丝无奈。
他身形一闪，瞬间出现在段苒苒身前，阻拦住她的去路。
“姑娘，莫要放弃生的希望。”苏铭沉声道。
段苒苒抬起头，眼中满是迷茫与绝望，泪水不受控制地滚落：“段家之人皆已死去，苒苒活着又有何意义？”
“姑娘，逝者已逝，然生者当自强。你若就这般放弃，如何对得起那些逝去之人对你的期许？”苏铭目光灼灼，试图唤醒她心中的斗志。
段苒苒身躯一震，眼中闪过一丝挣扎，内心似在天人交战。
苏铭见状，继续说道：“姑娘如此美貌，世间还有诸多美好未及领略，怎可轻易言弃？”
段苒苒咬着下唇，泪水依旧不断流淌，却不再像之前那般绝望。
“公子……”她轻声呢喃，声音带着一丝迷茫与期待。
苏铭微微颔首，神色柔和：“姑娘，且随我来，定助你找回生的希望。”
段苒苒犹豫片刻，终是缓缓点头，迈出了跟随苏铭的脚步。
……

一夜苦修。
苏铭只觉体内灵力如汹涌浪潮，疯狂翻涌。
“突破了？竟然达到聚元境六层！阴阳神诀果真是神奇！”苏铭满脸震惊，心中狂喜。此前吸收无数灵石，修为如顽石般纹丝不动，如今竟一朝突破。
第二日，晨曦微露。
苏铭准备赶回紫云宗杂役任务堂，交接任务。
他找到段苒苒，神色认真：“苒苒，一月之后紫云宗开山收徒，你可来紫云宗拜师求道，届时你会认识诸多同道之友，就不会感到孤独了。”
段苒苒抬眸，目光如水，轻声应道：“好。”
可心底却一片苦涩，她深知自己毫无修仙资质，这拜师一事，不过是镜花水月。
苏铭离去，背影逐渐消失在视线中。
段苒苒呆立原地，忽然，她心中一惊，竟察觉到体内有丝丝灵力流转。
“这……这是修为？”段苒苒美目圆睁，难以置信。
她急忙回忆昨晚，苏铭在旁，难道……
段苒苒抬眼，望向苏铭离去的方向，眼中满是复杂之色，有震惊，有疑惑，更有一抹难以言说的情愫，那目光深处，仿若全是苏铭的身影。
紫云宗，杂役任务堂。
“嘿，瞧啊，这不是苏铭嘛！”
“可不是，这才过去不到三天，竟就回来了，指定是接的任务太难，搞不定咯。”
“哼，我就说嘛，就他也想完成那种任务，简直白日做梦，妥妥一废物！”
众人你一言我一语，嘲讽声在杂役任务堂内肆意回荡。
content_en:
"Young Master, Ranran is willing to pledge myself to repay your life-saving grace." Duan Ranran's voice was trembling.
Her figure is gentle and soft, her face also has an alluring appearance, her skin is as good as snow, and her eyebrows are charming.
Su Ming frowned slightly and refused without hesitation: "Girl, this is absolutely unacceptable."
"Young Master, Ranran is clean and will never pester you, but the Duan family really can't give you anything valuable, so we can only repay your kindness and ask you to fulfill your wishes." Duan Ranran said eagerly, with pleading eyes.
Su Ming's expression was firm and his tone was sincere: "Girl, don't be like this. I, Su Ming, am definitely not the kind of casual person. Saving you is just a simple effort without any reward. Girl, please don't feel any psychological pressure."
When Duan Ranran heard this, his body trembled suddenly, and the blood on his face instantly faded, as if he had been struck by lightning. Her lips trembled, but she could no longer speak.
Finally, she staggered and turned around slowly. Her back was full of despair, and she left step by step, as if all her strength had been drained away.
Su Ming looked at the direction she was leaving and sighed in his heart, already seeing that she was determined to die.
"That's all, how can you just watch her seek death." Su Ming murmured to himself, with a hint of helplessness in his eyes.
He flashed and appeared in front of Duan Ranran, blocking her way.
"Girl, don't give up hope of living." Su Ming said solemnly.
Duan Ranran raised his head, his eyes full of confusion and despair, and tears rolled down uncontrollably: "Everyone in the Duan family is dead, so what's the point of Ranran's life?"
"Girl, the dead are gone, but the living should strengthen themselves. If you give up like this, how can you live up to the expectations of those who have passed away?" Su Ming's eyes were glaring, trying to awaken the fighting spirit in her heart.
Duan Ranran's body trembled, a trace of struggle flashed in his eyes, and his heart seemed to be at war between heaven and man.
Seeing this, Su Ming continued: "Girl is so beautiful, and there are still many beauties in the world that we have not yet experienced. How can we give up so easily?"
Duan Ranran bit her lower lip, tears still flowing, but no longer as desperate as before.
"Master..." She whispered softly, with a hint of confusion and expectation in her voice.
Su Ming nodded slightly, with a gentle expression: "Girl, come with me, I will help you find hope of life."
Duan Ranran hesitated for a moment, then nodded slowly and took steps to follow Su Ming.
…
A night of hard work.
Su Ming felt that the spiritual power in his body was like a raging wave, surging crazily.
"Breakthrough? He actually reached the sixth level of Juyuan Realm! The Yin-Yang Divine Art is truly magical!" Su Ming's face was filled with shock, and his heart was filled with ecstasy. Previously, he had absorbed countless spiritual stones, and his cultivation was as motionless as a stubborn stone, but now he had a breakthrough.
The next day, the morning light showed slightly.
Su Ming was about to rush back to the Ziyun Sect's Miscellaneous Task Hall to hand over the task.
He found Duan Ranran and said with a serious expression: "Ranran, in one month the Ziyun Sect will open the mountain to accept disciples. You can come to the Ziyun Sect to become a disciple and seek enlightenment. By then you will know many friends who share the same path, and you will not feel lonely."
Duan Ranran raised her eyes, her gaze was like water, and responded softly: "Okay."
But there was bitterness in her heart. She knew that she had no qualifications to become an immortal, and her apprenticeship was nothing more than a mirror.
Su Ming left, and his back gradually disappeared from sight.
Duan Ranran stood blankly on the spot. Suddenly, she was shocked and noticed that there was a trace of spiritual power flowing in her body.
"This...is this cultivation level?" Duan Ranran's beautiful eyes widened in disbelief.
She hurriedly recalled last night, Su Ming was by her side, could it be...
Duan Ranran raised his eyes and looked in the direction where Su Ming left. His eyes were full of complex expressions, including shock, confusion, and even an indescribable emotion. The depth of his eyes seemed to be filled with Su Ming's figure.
Ziyun Sect, Miscellaneous Task Hall.
"Hey, look, isn't this Su Ming!"
"No, it's only been less than three days and I'm back. The task I took was too difficult and I can't handle it."
"Hmph, let me tell you, even if he wants to complete that kind of task, it's just a daydream and a waste!"
everyoneYou said something to me, and the sarcasm echoed freely in the handyman task hall.
